Point size of the numeric labels of a Stem plot

Source: R/officer.R
stem_label_size.Rd

Internal helper reading back the size ggplot2 resolved for the in-plot numeric labels. The built layer data carries the value in millimetres, including the default that theme_stem() supplies through ggplot2::element_geom(), so the export follows a custom label_size without the caller having to repeat it.

Usage

stem_label_size(plot, built)

Arguments

plot

A ggplot object.

built

The result of ggplot2::ggplot_build() for plot.

Value

The label size in points. Falls back to 11 when the plot draws no labels at all.
